transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see us today?

I'm here because I've been having some really strange and intense thoughts lately that I can't seem to shake. It feels like people are monitoring me and that random everyday events have some sort of special, hidden meaning. It's gotten to the point where these thoughts are taking over my life.
Have you been experiencing any significant changes in your mood, such as feelings of depression or extreme highs, along with these strange thoughts?

Yes, I've been experiencing these incredible highs where I feel extremely energetic, happy, and constantly active. It feels like I have endless energy and don't need to rest, and these feelings definitely happen at the same time as those strange thoughts.
Do your strange thoughts and beliefs persist even when you're not experiencing those extreme highs or any other significant mood changes?

Yes, they absolutely do. Even when my mood is calm and completely normal, those thoughts and beliefs don't go away. In fact, there have been times where they've stuck around for two weeks or more without any of that high energy.
For how long have you been experiencing these strange thoughts and beliefs in total, and have they been present for at least six months?
Yes, I've been experiencing these strange thoughts and beliefs for about six months in total now. They have definitely been present for at least that long.
How have these thoughts and mood changes affected your daily life, such as your relationships, work, or ability to take care of yourself?

Honestly, it has made things quite difficult lately. My daily routine and relationships feel pretty disrupted, and it's just been hard to keep everything on track. I'm not entirely sure how to explain it, but things definitely haven't been normal.

Can you estimate how much of the six months you've been experiencing these symptoms was dominated by a mood episode, such as one of those highs, versus periods where your mood was relatively normal but the strange thoughts persisted?

The energetic highs have actually been present for the vast majority of the time I've been unwell over this past year and a half. However, there was a distinct period of about two or three weeks where my mood completely leveled out and felt normal, but the strange thoughts and hallucinations still persisted.

During that two or three week period when your mood was normal but the strange thoughts persisted, did you experience any hallucinations or disorganized behavior, or were the symptoms primarily delusional?

During those few weeks, it wasn't just the delusional thoughts about being monitored and having special powers. I was also hearing whispering voices when no one was around and seeing strange shadows out of the corner of my eye. It was incredibly overwhelming to deal with both the hallucinations and the delusions at the same time.
Can you tell me more about what you mean by 'having special powers' and how that relates to your delusional thoughts and hallucinations during that time?

During that time, I truly believed I had been chosen and given special healing powers and the ability to influence events around me. It felt incredibly real, especially when the whispering voices would confirm these abilities to me, and my high energy made me feel absolutely invincible. It was like everything in the universe was connected directly to me and my purpose.
Could you please clarify or repeat what you would like to know next? I want to make sure I answer your question correctly.
You mentioned the whispering voices confirmed your special abilities to you. Can you describe in more detail what these voices said and how they contributed to your belief in having special powers?

The voices would whisper to me constantly, telling me that I was chosen for a grand purpose and that I possessed extraordinary abilities others couldn't comprehend. They kept repeating that I had the power to heal people and control things with my mind. Because they spoke with such authority and conviction, it made me completely believe that what they were saying about my special powers was absolutely true.
